span.p:
tool_grants
Who may call which tool. tool_uid is the tool the grant was bound to when applied; a grant whose tool has since been replaced denies every call.

span.p:
tool_invocation_attempts
Each try at an invocation. idempotency_key is what a provider-idempotent tool repeats on every attempt; outcome stays null while an attempt runs or when an interrupted one could not be reconciled. (ADDED)

span.p:
tool_invocations
One accepted call. The resolved tool definition is copied in, so changing or deleting the Tool cannot change accepted work; grant_refs names the grants that allowed it, checked again before every dispatch. (ADDED)
